description: Weather-event probability: temp at covered stations; precip/wind any US point. Our model's probability that a condition occurs in a future window up to 31 days out, with the method labeled. Temperature events (above/below, window_stat max or min) answer at model-covered stations only — elsewhere they return INVALID_PARAMS rather than an estimate. Precipitation, wind, and named-storm events answer for any US point (NWS-derived). When a listed prediction market covers the same event, it is cross-referenced. [HTTP: GET /v1/climate-events/probability · price $0.05 via x402 · docs https://x402-factory.com/docs/edge.climate-events-probability]

city.description: Major US city name as an alternative to lat/lon

threshold.description: Metric units: °C for temp, mm for precip, kph for wind

window_stat.description: Binding statistic for temperature events: max (default) or min; exact semantics in docs
